author: Arnav
problem: Read N people and M photos, each a left-to-right ordering of all N people. Print how many pairs of people never stood next to each other in any photo, as an integer.
bug_description: Uses / instead of //, so the count is printed as a float (e.g. 1.0).

comments.accurate: Marks every pair that stood side by side in some photo and counts the unmarked pairs
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts never-adjacent pairs in both orders and divides by 2 with true division
comments.wrong_location: Pair counting verified; check the diagonal is subtracted only once per person
